name: 炉脉矮人·男·敦实
src: 主角预设（11-10）：矮人·炉脉，男，敦实
who: A young dwarf man of the Furnace Vein clan, from the royal forge-city of the Molten Iron Core, about twenty-two, a guild adventurer just starting out: about 140 cm, short and very broad. Deep garnet-red hair worn short and swept back, and a short garnet-red beard grown in a neat ring with two thick short braids ringed with small copper clasps; small pointed ears; gunmetal blue-grey eyes under a heavy straight brow, and a small old pale burn mark shaped like a spark on his left cheekbone (on the viewer's right when they face us). Fair skin. The proud, solid, slightly stubborn air of a man who has been told since birth that things must last for his grandchildren.
build: About 140 cm, a stocky, dwarven frame: very broad shoulders, thick arms and large strong hands, a thick neck, solid and heavy, standing like a small anvil.
palette: forge brown and iron grey, deep garnet red, copper, one small ember-orange accent
casual: A forge-city dwarf's everyday coat: a short, thick brown wool coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat, copper buttons and a riveted shoulder yoke over a grey shirt, a wide leather belt with a small hammer in a loop and heavy work gloves tucked into it, dark trousers tucked into thick-soled boots. Both thumbs hooked in the belt, a proud, slightly gruff look.
private: Off duty: a soft knitted grey sweater with the sleeves pushed up, comfortable brown trousers, thick wool socks and house shoes, the beard braids loose. He holds a big mug of dark ale in both hands. A satisfied, sleepy look.
battle: A guild adventurer's starting kit: a short, thick steel breastplate with open joints at the shoulders and elbows, heavy riveted pauldrons, a dark leather coat with a high collar under it, thick bracers, a belt with a guild token and the small tapping hammer, heavy boots. In his right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us) a short-hafted iron war hammer with a squared, banded head; a round iron shield is strapped to his left forearm (on the viewer's right when they face us). A wide, planted stance.
formal: Clan formal dress: a long deep garnet coat with a high collar, copper piping and a row of small copper buttons, the clan forge mark embroidered in dark thread at the back, a broad leather belt with a polished small hammer, white gloves, polished boots, the beard braids freshly ringed. Standing very square and stiff.
art: Seen slightly from below, the war hammer resting on his shoulder, his free hand tapping the small hammer at the belt, a proud, half-grinning look straight at the viewer, warm furnace-orange light from one side.
battle_note: Dwarf frame, about 140 cm; the beard and braids stay outside the armour collar and are not hidden. Pauldrons and breastplate keep open joints, and the clan mark is on the back side of the breastplate.

name: 炉脉矮人·女·敦实
src: 主角预设（11-10）：矮人·炉脉，女，敦实
who: A young dwarf woman of the Furnace Vein clan, from the royal forge-city of the Molten Iron Core, about twenty-two, a guild adventurer just starting out: about 135 cm, short and sturdy. Bright cobalt-blue hair in two thick braids pinned up and round her head, small pointed ears with a small gold stud in the lobe of her left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us), turquoise eyes under straight, strong brows, no beard. Fair skin. A brisk, proud, sharp-tongued air, a master smith's apprentice who will not be told twice.
face: FACE, as in the references: a grown woman's face of about twenty-two, a strong, firm chin and a straight nose, large turquoise eyes under straight brows, a mouth that curls up at one corner. NOT a child, not a girl's face.
build: About 135 cm, a sturdy, rounded dwarven frame: broad shoulders, strong arms and capable hands, solid and compact, with the weight of someone who lifts heavy things all day.
palette: forge brown and iron grey, cobalt blue, copper, one small gold accent
casual: A forge-city dwarf's everyday coat: a short, thick grey wool coat-dress with a stand collar buttoned to the throat, copper buttons and a riveted shoulder yoke over a cream shirt, a wide leather belt with a small hammer in a loop and heavy gloves tucked in, thick dark leggings tucked into thick-soled boots. Hands on the belt, a bold, confident smile.
private: At home in the evening: a soft knitted blue sweater with the sleeves pushed up, comfortable dark trousers, thick wool socks and house shoes, the braids loose over her shoulders. She holds a small cup of hot tea in both hands. A sleepy, contented smile.
battle: A guild adventurer's starting kit: a short, thick steel breastplate with open joints at the shoulders and elbows, riveted pauldrons, a dark leather coat with a high collar under it, thick bracers, a belt with a guild token and a small tapping hammer, heavy boots. In her right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us) a one-handed iron axe with a banded head; a round iron shield is strapped to her left forearm (on the viewer's right when they face us). A wide, planted stance.
formal: Clan formal dress: a long deep blue fitted coat-dress with a high collar, copper piping and small copper buttons, the clan forge mark embroidered at the back, a broad leather belt with a polished small hammer, white gloves, polished boots, the braids pinned up neatly. Standing very square and proud.
art: Seen slightly from below, the axe resting on her shoulder, the polished small hammer in her free hand, a bold, half-grinning look straight at the viewer, warm furnace-orange light on one side.
battle_note: Dwarf frame, about 135 cm; the pinned braids stay out and are not hidden under a helmet. Breastplate and pauldrons keep open joints, and the clan mark is on the back side of the breastplate.
